title: chore: rotate production OpenRouter API key
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Rotates only `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` in the encrypted Gen production secrets, with explicit maintainer approval.
- Scopes production synchronization to OpenRouter when it is the only changed secret; adds the same option for manual deployment.
- Preserves staging, development, and all other secret values.
- Validates the key with OpenRouter, verifies only its decrypted value changed, and checks workflow YAML and production scope selection. Biome passes.

gist.headline: One key, freshly turned
gist.blurb: The production OpenRouter key got a careful rotation, without disturbing the rest of the secret garden. Deployments can now sync just that one pollen grain when that is all that changed.
gist.summary: Rotated the encrypted production OPENROUTER_API_KEY and updated Cloudflare production deployment workflows to validate OpenRouter and synchronize only that secret when it is the sole change, while preserving staging, development, and other production secrets.
gist.impact: Production OpenRouter-backed text generation keeps running on a newly validated credential, with narrower secret synchronization for routine key rotations and manual deployments.
gist.visual_concept: A careful greenhouse key rotation: Polli acts as a tiny maintainer, replacing one glowing key in a labeled OpenRouter terminal cabinet while every other sealed jar remains untouched. A small CRT monitor robot verifies the single changed key, surrounded by code-plants and warm garden lights.
